task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC FOR TWO FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head 511de28; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Verify claims against the code (cite file:line) and extend the 'Review dispositions (2026-10-10)' list with items 14-15.

14. (P1, ~line 258) 'Bound selected rankings before enabling the B default': min_score=60 is a predicate, not a candidate bound — any number of the ~198.5M systems may score B or better, and _archetype_rankings_v3 still performs the unindexed cross-table ordering (archetype_score x confidence x completeness) and an uncapped COUNT(*) on every default picker request. CHANGE the design so the bounded selected-ranking API contract is a hard prerequisite for ALL selected-archetype modes (not just C/D): define it as a small API slice ('slice 1c', an apps/api change with its own PR, listed before F4b in the PR plan) that (a) makes the selected ordering index-satisfiable using the existing system_archetype_key_score index (sql/v3/migrations/011_v3_system_archetype.sql:49-50: (derived_generation_id, archetype_key, archetype_score DESC, system_id64)) — e.g. take a bounded candidate window ordered by archetype_score DESC (window size = offset ceiling, 10,000) and apply the confidence x completeness modifier only within that window, documenting the precise semantics; and (b) replaces the uncapped COUNT(*) with a capped count (count up to 10,001 and report is_truncated) so the UI's 'first 10,000 of TOTAL' becomes 'first 10,000 of 10,000+' when truncated. State that F4b may not be enabled (even behind the gate in E2E) until slice 1c has landed with a representative-scale timing proof (name the disposable PostgreSQL 18 fixture + a synthetic 1M-row scratch table as the proof vehicle). Re-check the earlier disposition 3 text so it no longer says the bound is deferred to C/D.

15. (P2, ~line 676) 'Seed enough systems to exercise pagination': the Product E2E fixture publishes exactly three systems (test_seed_publishes_and_exposes_journey_ids), the Explore page requests 24 rows and the rankings endpoint defaults to 50, so no Next transition exists for Cypress. CHANGE: specify a bounded page-size request parameter for the rankings facade (e.g. page_size, 1..50, default 50; confirm whether the endpoint already accepts `limit` — apps/api/src/routers/archetypes.py — and reuse it if so, citing the line) and have the E2E journey use page_size=1 so three systems yield three pages; the committed corpus stays at three systems. Mention the alternative (a larger synthetic corpus) and why it was not chosen. Update the F4a/F4b file lists and the validation plan accordingly.

Validation: git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — bounded selected ranking is a prerequisite for all selected modes; E2E pagination via page size'.
